versions.changelog:
kdp-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of an all-in-one Amazon KDP publishing toolkit.
- Supports conversion of Markdown manuscripts to KDP-compatible EPUB e-books.
- Generates low-content books (journals, planners, log books) as interior PDFs and supports batch creation.
- Automates cover design with AI prompt generation and KDP-spec validation.
- Provides metadata generation (keywords, categories, pricing) for easy KDP upload.
- Includes evaluation and description optimization tools to enhance publishing workflow.
